_note: Cost multipliers relative to the BASE (uncached) input-token price, so every cost is in input-token equivalents. Edit freely: analyze.py --pricing FILE reads this shape. Source: Anthropic prompt-caching price sheet as of 2026-10 (cache read 0.1x, 5-minute cache write 1.25x, 1-hour cache write 2x, output 5x input for the Opus/Sonnet/Haiku families). The ratios, not the dollar prices, decide the policy, and they are the same across those families.
_ping_note: Output tokens a keep-alive ping costs (the mod asks for a one-word reply; 60 covers a short answer plus overhead). Sensitivity runs 200.
_per_tool_note: Optional per_tool: {"codex": {"output": 8.0}, ...} overrides these ratios for one tool when the share-of-spend table weighs other vendors' tokens. Without it every tool is weighted with the ratios above. Only that table uses it; the policy search is Claude Code's alone.
